manifestName.message: Anti-Spoiler for YouTube™ – Hide Video Length & Progress Bar
manifestName.description: Extension name in Chrome, the Web Store and the toolbar button tooltip.

manifestDescription.message: Hide video length and the progress bar on YouTube to avoid spoilers in sports and esports replays.
manifestDescription.description: Extension description in Chrome and the Web Store. At most 132 characters.

manifestToggleCommand.message: Turn spoiler protection on or off

manifestRevealCommand.message: Show or hide spoilers for the open video
manifestRevealCommand.description: Keyboard shortcut description in chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Uncovers the open video, or covers it again.

popupName.description: Brand name at the top of the popup. Usually left untranslated.

popupStatusOn.description: Popup status title while protection is on. Shown in capitals.

popupStatusOff.description: Popup status title while protection is off. Shown in capitals.

popupNoteOn.message: Video time and duration are hidden
popupNoteOn.description: Line under the status title while protection is on.

popupNoteOff.description: Line under the status title while protection is off.

popupMasterSwitchLabel.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the main on/off switch in the popup.

popupHideProgressBar.description: Popup setting title: hides the video timeline.

popupHideProgressBarNote.message: In the player and in previews
popupHideProgressBarNote.description: Note under the "Hide progress bar" setting.

popupBlurPreviews.description: Popup setting title: blurs video thumbnails.

popupBlurPreviewsNoteLinked.description: Note under the "Blur previews" setting while video titles are linked to it, so they are blurred too.

popupBlurTitles.description: Popup setting title: blurs video titles.

popupBlurTitlesNote.message: In lists, on the video page and in end cards
popupBlurTitlesNote.description: Note under the "Blur video titles" setting.

popupBlurTitlesNoteLinked.description: Note under the "Blur video titles" setting while it is linked to "Blur previews" and follows it.

popupTitlesLinked.message: Linked to preview blur. Click to set separately.
popupTitlesLinked.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the chain button next to "Blur video titles" while title blur follows "Blur previews".

popupTitlesUnlinked.message: Set separately. Click to link to previews.
popupTitlesUnlinked.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the chain button next to "Blur video titles" while title blur is set on its own.

popupHideComments.description: Popup setting title: covers the comments under videos.

popupProtectLive.description: Popup setting title: pauses live streams before they show the current moment.

popupProtectLiveNote.message: Pause at the start and hide live chat
popupProtectLiveNote.description: Note under the "Protect live streams" setting.

popupBetaNote.message: Still being tested: it may not always work as expected
popupBetaNote.description: Tooltip on the English "Beta" badge next to the "Protect live streams" setting.

popupAdvancedSettings.description: Title of the collapsible section in the popup that holds the less used settings and the language.

popupLanguageLabel.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the language chip in the popup's top card.

popupSaveError.description: Popup error when a setting could not be saved.

popupLoadError.message: Could not load settings — close and reopen the popup
popupLoadError.description: Popup error when the settings could not be read; the popup is then read-only.

popupLanguageError.description: Popup error when the chosen language could not be loaded or saved.

popupThemeAuto.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the theme button in the popup while the theme follows the system.

popupThemeLight.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the theme button in the popup while the light theme is chosen.

popupThemeDark.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the theme button in the popup while the dark theme is chosen.

popupThemeError.description: Popup error when the chosen theme could not be saved.

popupAboutButton.description: Footer link of the popup that opens the About screen (about the extension and how to write to us); also the title of that screen.

popupAboutThanks.description: First line of the About sheet in the popup, shown larger: thanks to the user for using the extension.

popupAboutText.message: We made it so that every match, race and stream keeps its suspense to the very last minute.
popupAboutText.description: Text under the thank-you line in the About sheet: why the extension exists.

popupContactTitle.description: Heading of the contact block in the About sheet.

popupContactNote.message: Found a bug, missing a feature or have an idea? Write to us.
popupContactNote.description: Text above the contact email in the About sheet: where to write about bugs, missing features or ideas.

popupCopyEmail.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the button that copies the contact email.

popupEmailCopied.description: Short confirmation shown after the contact email was copied.

popupAboutBack.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the button that leaves the About screen and returns to the settings.

liveGuardTitle.description: Title of the panel over a paused live stream on YouTube.

liveGuardPaused.message: This live stream was paused before showing the current moment.
liveGuardPaused.description: Explanation in the live stream panel.

liveGuardUnknownStatus.message: Couldn't tell whether this is a live stream.
liveGuardUnknownStatus.description: Explanation in the live stream panel when the extension cannot tell whether the video is live.

liveGuardChecking.message: Checking whether the stream can be rewound…
liveGuardChecking.description: Status in the live stream panel while the rewind window is loading.

liveGuardCannotRewind.message: This stream can't be rewound. Continue live or leave the page.
liveGuardCannotRewind.description: Status in the live stream panel when the stream has no rewind window.

liveGuardJumpFailed.description: Status in the live stream panel after "Start from beginning" failed.

liveGuardStartButton.description: Live stream panel button: play the stream from its earliest point.

liveGuardContinueButton.description: Live stream panel button: jump to the live moment.

liveGuardPlayButton.description: Live stream panel button: play from where the video is, when it is unclear whether it is live.

liveGuardAdNote.message: Ad — the choice will appear after it
liveGuardAdNote.description: Small note over a live stream while an ad plays; the panel appears after the ad.

commentsHiddenTitle.description: Title of the cover over the comments under a video, in the comments panel and over live chat.

commentsShowButton.description: Button on the comments cover and the live chat cover that uncovers them for this video.

commentsCloseChat.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of the close (×) button on the live chat cover. Closes the chat panel like YouTube’s own close button.

skipBack10Minutes.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the −10m skip button in the YouTube player.

skipBack1Minute.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the −1m skip button in the YouTube player.

skipForward1Minute.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the +1m skip button in the YouTube player.

skipForward10Minutes.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the +10m skip button in the YouTube player.

mediaHiddenTitle.description: Title shown in the browser's and the system's media controls instead of the real video title while titles are hidden.

revealShowButton.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the eye button in the YouTube player. Uncovers the open video only.

revealHideButton.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the eye button in the YouTube player while the open video is uncovered. Covers it again.
